clauses.clause: Battalion — Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: The probe only attacks with this creature alone ([this creature attacks alone, unblocked], [attacks and opp_giant blocks it]): the trigger is checked and no counter is placed, which is right; another creature attacking without it does nothing. A three-creature attack never happens. Tree equals the compiler's parse (B5a-battalion). Packs: makeshift_battalion_three_attackers (it and two others attack: one +1/+1 counter on it only, 4/3, opponent takes 4+2+2 = 8) PASS; makeshift_battalion_two_attackers (it and one other attack: no counter, opponent takes 5) PASS. The second pack kills a mutant whose threshold is 2 attackers.
